lead: From historic seafront luxury to the best budget options. Exclusive and affordable hotels, all well located.

items.kicker: 5-star Grand Luxury hotel · The most luxurious in Valencia
items.title: Las Arenas Balneario Resort
items.subtitle: Historic spa resort since 1898 · 253 rooms · Spa · 2 pools · Brasserie Sorolla · Beachfront
items.body: Las Arenas Balneario Resort is the most luxurious hotel in Valencia. The original spa baths were founded in 1898 beside the Playa de las Arenas, and today the resort keeps its historic elegance with completely renovated 5-star Grand Luxury facilities. Its 253 rooms offer Mediterranean decor in neutral tones, some with direct sea views, WiFi, LED TV, minibar, bathrobe, slippers and a full bathroom. The luxury spa — with a heated indoor pool, sauna, massages and treatments —, the 2 outdoor pools with bar, the gardens for celebrations and the restaurant Brasserie Sorolla (Mediterranean cuisine with local produce) make this resort a destination in itself. It has 2,500 m² for congresses, a padel court and a kids’ club.

items.title: The Westin Valencia
items.subtitle: Modernista building · 135 Art Deco rooms · Westin Heavenly Bed® · 850 m² spa · Indoor tropical garden
items.body: The Westin Valencia is one of the most exclusive hotels in the city, located in one of the most impressive modernista buildings in Valencia in the prestigious El Pla del Real neighbourhood. Its 135 rooms and suites combine classic Art Deco architecture with contemporary design, equipped with the famous Westin Heavenly Bed® for unrivalled rest, minibar, coffee machine, WiFi, satellite TV, butler service and a luxury bathroom with jacuzzi in the suites. The 850 m² spa is one of the most complete in the city: heated indoor pool, Finnish sauna, Turkish bath, fitness centre with personal trainer and a wide range of massages. The hotel houses the restaurant Rosmarino (refined Mediterranean cuisine), a lobby bar and a wonderful indoor tropical garden. A 5-minute walk from Aragón metro and beside the Turia Gardens.

items.kicker: 1-star hotel · Carrer de les Roses, 31 · Manises
items.title: Travelodge Valencia Aeropuerto
items.subtitle: 800 m from the airport · Rosas metro at the door · 116 rooms · 24h bar · From ~€30/night
items.body: The Travelodge Valencia Aeropuerto is the most practical and economical option for travellers with an early or late flight. Located in Manises just 800 metres from the airport, it has the Rosas metro station literally across from the hotel, with a direct connection to the centre of Valencia in 20 minutes. Its 116 contemporary rooms include AC, flat-screen TV, WiFi in common areas and a private bathroom. The bar-café is open 24 hours and serves buffet breakfast, lunches and light dinners. It has paid private parking and is accessible and pet friendly. Also ideal for combining the airport with a visit to the Feria de Valencia.

items.kicker: Hotel · Calle Samaniego, 20 · El Carmen neighbourhood
items.title: Ad Hoc Carmen
items.subtitle: 15th-century building · Next to the Cathedral · 5 m ceilings · Family duplexes · Free bikes
items.body: The Hotel Ad Hoc Carmen is a hidden gem in the heart of Valencia’s old town. It occupies a building constructed at the end of the 15th century on Calle Samaniego, next to the Cathedral, the Torres de Serranos, the Palacio del Temple and the Plaza de la Virgen, on a quiet, silent pedestrian street. Its ceilings of approximately 5 metres high allow for rooms of generous dimensions: from singles to duplexes with 2 bathrooms and a private terrace/solarium, and family rooms for up to 6 people. All have AC, WiFi, TV, private bathroom and modern furniture. The hotel has an agreement with a café next to the Plaza de la Virgen for breakfasts at a special price. Bike rental is available.

items.kicker: Hotel · City of Arts and Sciences area
items.title: Hotel VillaCarlos
items.subtitle: Next to the CAC · Good price · Well connected · Quiet atmosphere
items.body: The Hotel VillaCarlos is a simple, well-located option in the City of Arts and Sciences area, perfect for travellers who want to be close to the Calatrava complex without paying the prices of the big hotels on the promenade. A practical hotel with functional rooms, well connected to the centre of Valencia and the beaches. Ideal for families and independent travellers looking for good value in one of the most modern and most visited areas of the city.

items.title: Hostal Venecia Plaza Centro
items.subtitle: On the main square · 87 rooms · Balconies onto the square · Buffet breakfast · The most central of all
items.body: The Hostal Venecia Plaza Centro combines the best possible location — right on the Plaza del Ayuntamiento, number 3 — with a value for money that is very hard to match. It occupies a lovely classic building completely renovated with 87 rooms equipped with AC, WiFi, flat-screen TV and safe. The most prized are those with a balcony with direct views of Valencia’s main square. Daily buffet breakfast, common TV room, 24-hour reception and luggage storage. A 5-minute walk from the Xàtiva metro station (with a direct connection to the airport) and 4 minutes from the Estación del Nord. An unbeatable option for exploring the historic centre on foot.
